name: Plate XLIII: The Hieroglyphic Monad
description: John Dee's Monas Hieroglyphica (1564): Moon, Sun, the cross of the Elements and the fire of Aries, all planets folded into one glyph. Struck in Viriditas: the greening power, the colour of the Emerald Tablet. Degree of Neophyte, rank 391 of the folio. “OBSCVRVM PER OBSCVRIVS”: The obscure by the more obscure.
